name: DPV light ball mount holder
description: 3D-printed ball mount holder for attaching a dive light arm to a DPV using a tank strap.
body: I designed and printed this low-profile ball-mount bracket to secure a dive light arm to a DPV using a tank strap. The printed bracket has a central ball-mount stud for compatible light hardware. The available print files are the BlackTip ball-mount bracket STL and its separate TPU squishy insert STL. The photographs show the finished parts, mounting holes, strap opening, and ball stud. Fit, material selection, strap retention, and attachment security need to be checked for your own DPV and lighting setup.

name: Genesis DPV holder
description: A custom Genesis DPV holder with curved supports and a separate printable spacer insert.
body: CAD views of my Genesis DPV holder show its curved support surfaces and the separate spacer insert. I am documenting the design and spacer geometry here; the included STL is for the spacer insert only, not the complete holder assembly. Fit, dimensions, installation, and retention need to be verified for the specific use.

Side CAD model of a cylindrical spacer insert
End CAD view of the circular spacer insert

name: Genesis DPV Compass Mount
description: A compact compass mount for the Genesis DPV that attaches using a tank strap or bungee.
body: I designed this simple compass mount for my Genesis DPV. It attaches using a tank strap or bungee and allows magnetic correction for the installed compass. I tested it with the DPV and observed no magnetic interference from the scooter. The STL file is available to download from the Designs listing. Confirm compass accuracy and attachment security with your own equipment before use.
